geometry_observations.interpretation: The sampled D opening is consistent with the designed 3.2 mm round radius and flat at x=-2.4 mm. These mesh values are not future physical-part measurements; circular features and rounds are tessellated approximations.

preparation_observations.orientation: Repaired mesh rotated 180 degrees about X and translated to minimum Z=0, placing the blind D-socket opening upward (+Z). This protects the socket from direct support where feasible but puts the raised front hub at the build plate.
preparation_observations.support_consequence: The 2 mm hub can elevate surrounding front-face regions and create broad underside overhangs. Nominal slicing contains support and support-interface paths, so zero support is not claimed.
preparation_observations.profile_observation: The slice record binds machine, process and filament profile files by digest, but their contents were not separately inspected; exact-setting/package compliance therefore remains subject to review.
preparation_observations.toolpath_scope: Nominal selected layer extrusion paths only; startup/shutdown and firmware execution are unverified. The preview is slicing/toolpath evidence, not a completed print.
